blocks.text:
The pace changes several times over these ten days. In Rio, you explore the city and visit viewpoints. In Iguazu, the focus shifts to the force of the falls and the national parks. Visconde de Mauá brings mountain roads, walks and natural pools. In Paraty, you take a jeep through the forest and discover cachaça, traditional cassava flour production and the coast.

There is no long beach break in the middle of this itinerary. You do something different almost every day. First you look out over Rio from above and walk through its old neighbourhoods, then you spend time in nature around Iguazu. From there you head to small mountain settlements and the Atlantic Forest. The trip ends in Paraty with a mix of history, local traditions and time by the sea, so each stretch has a different focus.
